default/32616.htm.text: Fortune-Teller Mine: The future is enshrouded by a dark mist. Are you curious as to what it holds? For a small price, I can show you your future...

default/32616-1.htm.text: Fortune-Teller Mine: Your soul shines with a bright light. I see a dim image of a person walking, illuminated by that light... To see more, you must pay me an additional 1000 Adena . What do you say?

default/32616-2.htm.text: Fortune-teller Mine: Ah, well, perhaps it is better that you not know. Knowledge of the future can be a dangerous weapon... If you change your mind, come see me again. You must decide how closely you wish to peer into the mists of time...
